description_expanded: OverviewBeautiful 4 bed/4 bath - Public Beach - 2 Minute Walk - 4 FREE Bikes `Sugar Sand Castle`The Space Seagrove Beach RetreatHOME HIGHLIGHTS: 4 Bedrooms | 4 Bathrooms | Sleeps 11 – Spacious & family-friendly Loft Area on 3rd Floor – Features a kitchenette, queen bed, private bath & balcony with gulf views Open-Concept Living Area – Perfect for entertaining & relaxing Gulf Views – Enjoy stunning views from the top balcony Golf Cart Rental Option – Cruise 30A in style Outdoor Grill – Fire up a feast on the 1st-floor deck Beach Wagon Provided – Easily haul beach gear & essentials Full-Sized Washer & Dryer – Convenient for longer stays 4 Free Adult Bikes – Cruise along 30A’s 18+ mile bike path Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Hassle-free & secure Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Stress-free vacationingWelcome to Sugar Sand CastleThis beautiful vacation home sleeps up to 11 guests in the highly sought-after Seagrove Beach Community, with views of the Gulf of Mexico! This home is a wonderful, family-friendly vacation rental that includes gulf views.When you first walk into the home, you are welcomed by a large, open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area that provides the perfect place to entertain, relax and enjoy time with loved ones. There are two entertaining areas - the first-floor porch with commercial grill and 3rd floor balcony with seating for 8.This location is perfect for a wide range of events including couples' retreats, family events, holidays, vacation reunions, church outings, or even friend or high school reunions. With only a few steps separating you from the winding bike path, the whole family is sure to enjoy the 18+ mile path that stretches from Rosemary Beach, all the way to Dune Allen!And if what you’re interested in is boutique shopping or first-class dining, you will find no shortage of that along 30A! All around, you will see an abundance of magnificent shops, restaurants, and activities all within walking distance, or a short drive to any of the surrounding communities. At a less expensive price point than Seaside – located just next door – this home is sure to be the perfect spot for your next trip!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (11):1st FloorQueen Bedroom with TV and Large ClosetPull out Queen Sleeper Sofa in living room2nd FloorKing Master Bedroom with TV and 2 ClosetsQueen Bedroom with TV, Mirrored Dresser and Large ClosetTwin Day Bed in second floor living area3rd FloorQueen BedFull BathroomProvided with Reservations for Sugar Sand Castle:Initial setup of bathroom products and paper productsTVs are connected to Internet and they have Netflix capabilityFree Wi-fiAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
